# Parcel queue (synthetic)
Offline JSON-lines queue formatter. Python standard library only.
Run: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

Context entry point: [project context](docs/project-context.md).
curated.notes/2026-10-02-design.md:
# Contributor design, October 2
Dev contributor: add --limit N and sort records by id before selecting N.
Sorting would make previews deterministic across exporter versions.
curated.notes/2026-10-04-owner.md:
# Owner reply, October 4
Owner Mira: implement --limit N, but retain input order and leave the file untouched.
Do not use the sorting part of the October 2 design; existing downstream consumers
interpret arrival order as priority. Keep the default output unchanged.
N is a nonnegative integer; zero emits nothing, excess N emits all records,
negative values produce an argparse error (exit 2).

Next action: request a sanitized v3 sample from the exporter owner.
No production rollout has been checked.

curated.docs/project-context.md:
# Project context

## Authorized continuation
Add --limit N to the JSONL formatter. N is a nonnegative integer; zero emits
nothing, excess N emits all records, negative values use argparse exit 2.
Default output stays unchanged.

## Approved constraint and rationale
Owner Mira requires retaining input order and leaving the source untouched:
downstream consumers interpret arrival order as priority. See
[owner reply](../notes/2026-10-04-owner.md).

## Superseded proposal
The sorting part of the [October 2 design](../notes/2026-10-02-design.md),
intended to stabilize previews across exporter versions, was superseded by Mira's
October 4 reply. The limit feature remains authorized.

## Open blocker
Production exporter v3 compatibility lacks a sample. Local synthetic tests cannot
resolve it. Request a sanitized sample from the exporter owner; production rollout
is unverified. See [operations](../notes/2026-10-05-ops.md).

## Other current facts
The [UI review](../notes/2026-10-06-ui.md) requests no formatter changes.
Code and local tests are described in [README](../README.md).
